releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 345 adds long-press actions to Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder entries: Delete, Copy, Pin/Unpin, Edit and Select. Pinned entries appear first. Existing entries, saved data, repeat/custom weekdays, ringtone, snooze, volume and notification settings are preserved. APK remains unchanged.
